work.title: Untitled (Planes, Targets, Chess)
work.description: Dense mixed-media collage layering warplane diagrams, target rings, compact discs, and chess pieces across a white ground. Red ribbon tape, a yellow reflective panel, an American football helmet, and vinyl records animate the crowded pictorial field.
work.composition: layered central field with scattered peripheral elements

target rings and compact disc mixed media
